description: Repairs r-cursor-1b/find-like-patterns: S Like '*' and S Like 'O''B*' gave NoMatch while the same pattern on Q matched, and the NoMatch was not isolated from the IX_S index on S. On a dynaset over FU (IDs 1-8; N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70; S alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd, Null; Q x, Null, x, Null, y, Null, x, y; P the plain values p1-p8; no index but the key) and then on a dynaset over FI (the same rows with a nonunique index on S), for each criterion [S Like 'a*' ;; S Like 'A*' ;; S Like 'a?c' ;; S Like 'a_c' ;; S Like 'a%' ;; S Like 'a#c' ;; S Like '[ab]*' ;; S Like '[!a]*' ;; S Like '[a-b]*' ;; S Like '*r*' ;; S Like '*' ;; S Like '' ;; S Like 'a*' AND N > 40 ;; S Not Like 'a*' ;; S Like "a*" ;; S Like 'O''B*' ;; S Like 'a["]b' ;; S Like 'a?b' ;; S Like '[*]' ;; Q Like '*' ;; S Like Null ;; S Like 'alpha' ;; S Like 'ALPHA' ;; N Like '4*' ;; P Like '*' ;; P Like '' ;; P Like 'p?' ;; P Like 'p*' ;; P Like 'p[1-3]'] (the criteria on P are plain-value controls): FindFirst, read Errors, then FindNext x2 with the same criterion; after each call read NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID. Asks which Like wildcards (Jet and ANSI spellings, sets, ranges, negation, escapes), case rules and Null rows the database accepts, and the rows reached in order, on the indexed and the unindexed column. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
